name: Overwhelming Energy Drain (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Energy drain, Ability Focus (energy drain), Cha 13

Benefit(s): Your touch has a chance of dispelling spells and effects that protect against your energy drain attack (such as death ward). Your caster level is equal to your Challenge Rating. Even if you successfully dispel this effect, you cannot bestow negative levels until the following round.
